name: MISS ROSE Liquid Concealer | Ivory 6 | Waterproof High-Coverage Formula (5ml)
description:
Achieve a flawless, even complexion with MISS ROSE Liquid Concealer in shade Ivory 6. This lightweight yet full-coverage formula instantly hides dark circles, redness, blemishes, fine lines, and uneven skin tone. Waterproof, crease-resistant, and long-lasting, it blends effortlessly for a smooth, natural-looking finish. Suitable for all skin types and perfect for daily makeup or glam looks.Key Features:
 Full-coverage liquid formula for flawless concealment
 Waterproof, long-lasting & crease-resistant
 Lightweight texture blends effortlessly
 Covers dark circles, acne marks & redness
 Suitable for all skin typesHow to Use:
1⃣ Apply small dots under eyes or on blemishes.
2⃣ Tap gently with fingertip or brush to blend.
3⃣ Build additional layers if needed.
4⃣ Set with loose or compact powder.
5⃣ Apply after foundation for best results.Ingredients:
Aqua, Glycerin, Titanium Dioxide, Mica, Dimethicone, Mineral Pigments, Vitamin E.Safety Information:
 For external use only.
 Avoid direct contact with eyes.
 Discontinue if irritation occurs.
 Store in a cool, dry place.

Package Includes:
